newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel to build $100 million plant in Texas.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel to build $100 million plant in Texas.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc., a maker of speciality tires and wheels, said Friday it has selected Brownsville, Texas, as the location for a new $100 million manufacturing plant.
The plant will produce tires for use in agricultural, construction and speciality applications.
The Brownsville tire plant is expected to employ 500 to 700 workers and to contribute $200 million to $250 million in sales for the company, Titan said.

Titan currently operates a plant in Des Moines, Iowa, that makes agricultural and construction tires, and a Clinton, Tenn., plant where smaller diameter industrial, all terrain vehicle and trailer tires are made.
